scripts.dev: npm run build -w @linkedout/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @linkedout/shared" "npm run dev -w @linkedout/api" "npm run dev -w @linkedout/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @linkedout/shared && npm run build -w @linkedout/api && npm run build -w @linkedout/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @linkedout/shared && npm run typecheck -w @linkedout/api && npm run typecheck -w @linkedout/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @linkedout/shared && npm run test -w @linkedout/api && npm run test -w @linkedout/web
